mapper.select: SELECT a.agent_id AS owner_id, a.agent_code AS owner_code, a.agent_name AS owner_name, a.status AS owner_status, a.latest_version_no AS version_no, FALSE AS released, (a.status = 'ENABLED') AS active FROM squad_chat.sq_agent a JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version_tool b ON b.agent_version_id = a.latest_version_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.tool_id = #{toolId} UNION ALL SELECT a.agent_id AS owner_id, a.agent_code AS owner_code, a.agent_name AS owner_name, a.status AS owner_status, r.release_no AS version_no, TRUE AS released, (a.status = 'ENABLED') AS active FROM squad_chat.sq_agent a JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_release r ON r.release_id = a.current_release_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_release_tool rt WHERE rt.release_id = r.release_id AND rt.tool_id = #{toolId} ) ORDER BY released DESC, active DESC, owner_code ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool SET tool_name = #{toolName}, display_alias = #{displayAlias}, latest_version_id = #{latestVersionId}, latest_version_no = #{latestVersionNo}, latest_readiness = #{latestReadiness}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool SET status = #{status}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = 'DISABLED', revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND revision = #{revision}
UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool SET revision = revision WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ENABLED' AND latest_readiness = 'READY'
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(tool_code) FROM squad_chat.sq_tool WHERE tool_code LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
